name: Envry Local Email Testing
free_limit: Free MIT-licensed local email testing app and headless server for Windows, macOS and Linux. Captures SMTP messages without delivering them externally; includes per-recipient mailboxes, POP3/IMAP, REST API, simulated provider APIs and failure testing. No provider-imposed message quota or subscription expiry is stated.
watch_out: Early development before v1.0 with possible breaking changes. Unsigned desktop installers may trigger OS security warnings. Local SMTP accepts any credentials by default; use only in trusted development environments, protect test mail and ports, and provide your own device, CI resources and storage.
